parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const eventType=String(b.eventType??'signature_request').trim().toLowerCase(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const contractId=String(b.contractId??'').trim(); const sellerId=String(b.sellerId??'').trim(); const buyerId=String(b.buyerId??'').trim(); const idempotencyKey=String(b.idempotencyKey??('esignature:create:'+dealId+':'+contractId)).trim(); if(!dealId||!contractId||!idempotencyKey) throw new Error('dealId, contractId and idempotencyKey are required'); if(!['signature_request','contract.signature.requested','signature.void'].includes(eventType)) throw new Error('Unsupported e-signature eventType'); const payload=b.payload??{}; const signers=Array.isArray(payload.signers)?payload.signers:[]; if(eventType!=='signature.void'&&signers.length<1) throw new Error('At least one signer is required'); return [{json:{schemaVersion:'1.0',providerCategory:'esignature',operation:eventType==='signature.void'?'void_package':'create_package',idempotencyKey,correlationId:String(b.correlationId??('esignature:'+dealId+':'+contractId)),entity:{dealId,contractId,sellerId,buyerId,propertyId:String(b.propertyId??'')},payload:{packageName:String(payload.packageName??('Deal '+dealId+' Contract')),documentIds:Array.isArray(payload.documentIds)?payload.documentIds:[],signers:signers.map(s=>({signerId:String(s.signerId??s.id??''),name:String(s.name??''),email:String(s.email??''),role:String(s.role??''),required:s.required!==false})),message:String(payload.message??''),callbackUrl:String(payload.callbackUrl??'')},metadata:{source:'canonical-contract-esignature-engine',eventType,requestVersion:'1.0'}}}];
